name: Methandrostenolone
summary: Metandienone, also known as methandienone or methandrostenolone and sold under the brand name Dianabol (D-Bol) among others, is an androgen and anabolic steroid (AAS) medication which is mostly no longer prescribed. It is also used non-medically for physique- and performance-enhancing purposes. It is often taken by mouth.
